Actually even 8x as efficient.

An old 100 W incandescent bulb produced about 1500 lumens, and now a LED bulb of 12 or 13 W can produce slightly more than that.

In the now distant past, I used only 100 W incandescent bulbs, all of which had been replaced more than a decade ago with 13 W LED bulbs, so I have benefited from this 8x reduction in energy consumption.

The other significant reduction in electrical energy consumption happened when I replaced a many-decades-old refrigerator with a modern high-efficiency refrigerator.

Compared with a half century ago when I was a child, now I consume additional electrical energy with some computers, one or two of which are almost always on, and with a microwave oven used for cooking, but the additional energy consumption is normally less than what is saved by modern lighting and refrigeration technologies.

epistasis 2026/10/14 21:31
在美国，由于电网成本（公用事业账单的一部分），公用事业公司允许公用事业公司收取固定的利润率。因此，如果公用事业公司在该电网“维护”项目上承担 20% 的费用，则公用事业公司会尽可能提高价格。

这就是为什么分布式太阳能实际上比公用事业规模太阳能全包更便宜的原因：即使您支付 3 倍的初始安装成本，您也需要更少的非常昂贵的电网。

In the US, it's due to the cost of the grid, the part of the utility bill that PUCs allow utilities to charge a fixed rate of profit. So if utilities take 20% on that grid "maintenance" project, the utility drives up the price as high as possible.

This is why distributed solar is actually cheaper than utility scale solar all-in: you need less of that very very expensive grid, even if you pay 3x on the initial install costs.

1970年，英国国内电网和发电厂自1948年起一直为国有，基本上由公务员管理。这种情况一直持续到 1990-91 年，当时它被撒切尔夫人和主要政府（均为保守党）全部私有化。

现在到 2026 年，主要发电商是 EDF（法国国有）、RWE（德国）和 Scottish Power（西班牙拥有）。这些公司往往不公布高管薪酬，但早在 2012 年，英国 EDF 首席执行官的年薪就达到 120 万英镑。

我认为，所有这些都与价格上涨的原因有关。

In 1970 the UK domestic electricity grid and generating plants had been state owned since 1948, and was basically run by civil servants. This lasted until 1990-91 when it was all privatised by the Thatcher and Major governments (both Conservative).

Now in 2026 the main generators are EDF (French state owned), RWE (German), and Scottish Power (Spanish owned). These companies tend not to publish executive pay, but back in 2012 the CEO of EDF in the UK was being paid £1.2 million a year.

I would submit that all this has some bearing on why the prices have gone up.

bluGill 2026/10/14 22:43
> 不过，您不能真正认为白光在其主要目标（照明）方面并不更有效。

事实上，白光的效果要差得多。 红光不会影响你的夜视能力，黄光也不会影响你的夜视能力。 白光意味着您可以清楚地看到光所在的位置，但您无法看到超出该半径的区域，因此需要更多的光。我不需要在晚上看到颜色（白色很好），我只需要及时看到危险并避免它们，因此白色对于目标来说要差得多。

更糟糕的是，离开白光后，你的眼睛需要近一个小时才能完全适应黑暗。 因此，如果灯光熄灭或者您必须离开灯光照射的地方，您也将看不到东西。

只有当您有足够的白光以确保下一小时内您想看到的所有物体都被完全照亮时，白光才有用。 如果有任何例外，那么您不应该使用白色精简版。

> you can't really argue that the white light isn't more effective at it's primary goal (illumination) though.

IN fact white light is MUCH MUCH less effective. Red light doesn't affect your night vision, and yellow isn't much behind. White light means you can see very well where the light it, but you can't see beyond that radius and so more light is needed. I don't need to see colors at night (where white it good), I just need to see the dangers in time to avoid them, and so white is much worse for the goal.

Just to make it worse, it takes nearly an hour for your eyes to fully adjust to dark after leaving white light. So if the lights go off or you have to leave the place where they are shining you can't see as well.

White light is only good when you have enough of it that everything you want to see for the next hour is fully illuminated. If there is any exception to that, then you shouldn't have white lite.

确实如此，但除了杀虫剂和栖息地破坏之外，强烈的夜间照明也可能导致昆虫迷失方向。凡是昆虫多的地方，晚上一盏强烈的白灯就会在周围迅速积聚死去的昆虫。

我住在欧洲，当我还是个孩子的时候，那里有大量不同种类的昆虫。如果我在家里散步，我可能会看到至少 10 种不同目的昆虫。

如今，唯一仍然丰富的昆虫是真正的昆虫（半翅目），因此所有其他昆虫大多都消失了（少数昆虫，如蚊子，可能仍会时不时地出现）。我不知道原因，但我认为真正的虫子可能对杀虫剂具有更强的抵抗力。

True, but besides insecticides and habitat destruction it is possible that the strong nocturnal lighting, which disorients insects, has contributed to this. Wherever insects are abundant, a strong white lamp at night will accumulate quickly dead insects around it.

Where I live, in Europe, when I was a child there was a great abundance of insects of many different kinds. If I did a walk around my home I could see insects from perhaps at least 10 different orders.

Nowadays, the only insects that are still abundant are the true bugs (Hemiptera) why all others have mostly disappeared (a few, like mosquitoes, may still be seen from time to time). I do not know the reason, but I assume that the true bugs might be more resistant to insecticides.
